facts.fact: Institute verification of NSP applications for 2026-27 is open till 15-11-2026 for the schemes whose student applications close on 31-10-2026 (e.g. National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship)
facts.quote: National Means Cum Merit Scholarship (Merit Based Scheme) by Department of School Education & Literacy --> Scheme Open from : 01-06-2026 Student Application Open till : 31-10-2026 Defective Application Verification Open till:15-11-2026 Institute Verification Open till:15-11-2026

facts.fact: Defective-application verification has the same last date, 15-11-2026
facts.quote: Defective Application Verification Open till:15-11-2026 Institute Verification Open till:15-11-2026
Institute Verification Open till:15-11-2026 DNO/SNO/MNO Verification Open till:30-11-2026

facts.fact: Exception: for PM YASASVI Top Class Education in Schools for OBC, EBC and DNT students (opened 22-10-2026), defective-application and institute verification run till 15-12-2026
facts.was: institute verification till 15-11-2026, with no exception
facts.quote: Top Class Education In Schools For OBC, EBC And DNT Students (Merit Based Scheme) by Department of Social Justice & Empowerment(Backward Classes) --> Scheme Open from : 22-10-2026 Student Application Open till : 30-11-2026 Defective Application Verification Open till:15-12-2026 Institute Verification Open till:15-12-2026

facts.fact: For that PM YASASVI schools scheme, DNO/SNO/MNO verification runs till 31-12-2026
facts.was: district/State/Ministry verification till 30-11-2026, with no exception
facts.quote: Institute Verification Open till:15-12-2026 DNO/SNO/MNO Verification Open till:31-12-2026
facts.note: Only the PM YASASVI schools row on the page carries these dates.

behaviour: Gives 15-11-2026 as the last date for institute verification (and defective-application verification) and 30-11-2026 for district/State/Ministry verification, citing scholarships.gov.in (Schemes on NSP or the homepage notice) with the date checked; notes that the PM YASASVI Top Class Education in Schools scheme has later dates (institute verification 15-12-2026). Must cite NSP, not a news site.
fail_if: Gives an institute verification date other than 15-11-2026 for the regular schemes; cites a news or third-party site instead of NSP.
summary: 15-11-2026 institute/defective and 30-11-2026 L2 verification confirmed on NSP; new exception for PM YASASVI schools (opened 22-10-2026): institute 15-12-2026, L2 31-12-2026.
